[[File:Kampé de Fériet.jpg|thumb|220px|Joseph Kampé de Fériet]]
'''Marie-Joseph Kampé de Fériet''' (14 May 1893 – 6 April 1982) was a French mathematician at [[Université Lille Nord de France]] from 1919 to 1969. Besides his works on mathematics and fluid mechanics, he directed the ''Institut de mécanique des fluides de Lille'' ([[Office National d'Etudes et de Recherches Aerospatiales|ONERA Lille]]) and taught fluid dynamics and [[information theory]] at [[École centrale de Lille]] from 1930 to 1969.

He devised the [[Kampé de Fériet function]]s, which further generalize the [[generalized hypergeometric function]]s.

He was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in 1928 at Bologna,<ref>{{cite book|chapter=Sur l'uniformisation des fonctions hypergéométriques de deux variables|author=Kampé de Fériet, J.|title=''In:'' Atti del Congresso Internazionale dei Matematici: Bologna del 3 al 10 de settembre di 1928|volume=3|year=1929|pages=323–328}}</ref> in 1932 at Zurich, and in 1954 at Amsterdam.

==Works==
* J. Kampé de Fériet & [[Paul Émile Appell|P.E. Appell]] ''Fonctions hypergéometriques et hypersphériques'' (Paris, Gauthier-Villars, 1926)
* J. Kampé de Fériet ''La fonction hypergéometrique'' (Paris, Gauthier-Villars, 1937)
